lines.en: label dormwarssix11:
scene black

{size=-2}There’s an awkward transition between Location A and Location B that’s hard to quantify in terms of text, so I have taken this opportunity to flip the transitory black CG upside down so you better understand what I mean.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}地点 A 与地点 B 之间有一段尴尬的过渡，很难用文字量化。所以我借这个机会，把那张过渡用的黑色 CG 倒了过来，好让你更明白我的意思。{/size}

lines.en: It doesn’t {i}look{/i} much different, sure. But now that you know it’s upside down, I hope you’ll adjust your view of what’s happening to reflect the mildly incorrect nature of what I’m currently telling you.
lines.zh: 当然，它{i}看起来{/i}没什么不同。不过既然你现在知道它是倒着的，我希望你能调整对正在发生之事的看法，以映照出我此刻所说的话那种略微失真的性质。

lines.en: Think of the sky like a zipline and the powerlines that dot it like smaller, more electrical ziplines. We ascend the nearby poles like trees with our EH-rated safety boots and connect once our hands become fists.
lines.zh: 把天空想成一条滑索，点缀其上的电线则是更小、更带电的滑索。我们穿着 EH 级安全靴，像爬树一样攀上附近的电线杆，等双手握成拳，便接上了头。

lines.en: {size=-2}And in the moment where black becomes kcalb, we’re united under the watch of three moons each trying to out-moon the other in a vicious battle royale we should probably sell tickets to, but don’t. Three blocks left.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}而在 black 倒过来变成 kcalb 的那一刻，我们在三轮月亮的注视下合为一体，每一轮都想比过另外两轮。这场凶残的大逃杀真该卖票，可我们没有。还剩三个街区。{/size}

lines.en: Joined at my hip is the torso of someone smaller than me as I was born with the gift of always being bigger than how I feel. If I shaved with Occam’s Razor, I’d have no trouble blaming God for this.
lines.zh: 贴在我髋边的是某个比我矮小的人的躯干，而我天生就有一种本事：永远比自己的感受显得更大。要是我用奥卡姆剃刀刮一刮，倒是可以毫不费力地把这事怪到上帝头上。

lines.en: But as a man with little talent and even less body hair, I’ve naught to do but spare passing glances down at those who pass me on the way to a family home. Two blocks.
lines.zh: 可作为一个没什么才华、体毛更少的男人，我除了低头瞥几眼那些在回家路上与我擦肩而过的人，别无他事可做。两个街区。

lines.en: Like ants we are beneath this sky — our death spiral severed and elongated so that we stretch from here to Mars. So we’re still marching endlessly, but at least the scenery changes now.
lines.zh: 在这片天空下，我们就像蚂蚁——我们的死亡螺旋被切断、拉长，从此处一直延伸到火星。所以我们仍在无尽地行军，但至少现在的景色会变了。

lines.en: And oh, how it changes. Rearranges. It’s a tale for all the ages waging war against the pages in a book that’s still unwritten. I’ve been smitten. And the colors have dulled over time.
lines.zh: 噢，它变得多么厉害。重新排列着。这是一个属于所有时代的故事，正与一本尚未写就的书页开战。我被击中了。而那些颜色也随着时间黯淡下去。

lines.en: First red. Then pink. Now, a greyish, pale-ish brown. But even when defiant, I’m a tyrant. And I know that up is good and down is bad so I look to the skies but then, suddenly-
lines.zh: 先是红。然后粉。现在，是发灰、发白的褐。但即便是在反抗的时候，我也是个暴君。我知道上为好、下为坏，于是我望向天空，可就在这时，突然——

lines.en: A tugging at my sleeve. Three raps upon my chamber door. But it’s a murder of crows instead of a single raven.
lines.zh: 有人在扯我的袖子。我的房门被敲了三下。可来的不是一只乌鸦，而是一群乌鸦。

lines.en: And I’m not sure who to speak to when they’re all cawing at once.
lines.zh: 它们同时呱呱叫着，我不知道该跟谁说话。

lines.en: One block.
lines.zh: 一个街区。

lines.en: No blocks.
lines.zh: 没有街区了。

lines.en: scene skitwar1
Tamerlane.
lines.zh: Tamerlane。

lines.en: : Hello and welcome back to Sakaki-bar-a! And thank you for once again choosing my business as the place you most wanted to end another year of the Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 大家好，欢迎回到 Sakaki-bar-a！也感谢你们再次选择我的店，作为结束又一年宿舍战争的地方。

lines.en: scene skitwar2
: For those who don’t already know, my name is Sara. And I’ll be the host of your final competition this time.
lines.zh: : 给还不认识我的人介绍一下，我叫 Sara。这次的最后一场比赛由我来主持。

lines.en: : When I say “host,” though, I mostly mean I’m just going to explain the rules and how your acts will be judged since this {i}is{/i} an acting competition at the end of the day and I can definitely not act.
lines.zh: : 不过我说的「主持」，主要就是解释规则、说明你们的表演会怎么评分——毕竟这{i}毕竟{/i}是一场演技比赛，而我绝对不会演戏。

lines.en: : Nor does anyone probably want me to since I’m not a member of your class and can not help either side obtain the rights to Sensei’s entire person.
lines.zh: : 大概也没人想看我演，因为我不是你们班的人，也帮不了任何一方争取到老师整个人的所有权。

lines.en: : You look young enough to be a member of the class. I assumed you were Sana’s older sister when I first saw you.
lines.zh: : 你看着挺年轻，完全能当我们班的学生。我第一次见你时，还以为你是 Sana 的姐姐。

lines.en: scene skitwar3
: I am pleased to announce that the second floor wins. Thank you to everyone who showed up today. Please buy a lot of the non-alcoholic beer I purchased now that the Dorm Wars is over. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴地宣布，二楼获胜。感谢今天到场的每一位。宿舍战争既然结束了，请多多购买我采购的无酒精啤酒。谢谢。

lines.en: : Hey! That ain’t fair! I ain’t even gotten a shot to show off my acting chops yet and you’re ready to just hand a whole friggin’ chicken dinner down to the tall girl?! This is discrimination, I tell ya!
lines.zh: : 嘿！这不公平！我连展示演技的机会都还没捞着，你就准备把整份该死的鸡肉晚餐拱手让给那个高个子女孩了？！我告诉你，这是歧视！

lines.en: : Fight flattery with flattery. I can’t see it not working, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 以奉承制奉承。老实说，我看这招不可能不奏效。

lines.en: : Yo, Sana’s mom! You look pretty and young and whatever!
lines.zh: : 哟，Sana 的妈妈！你看起来又漂亮又年轻，之类的！

lines.en: scene skitwar4
: The contest is back on and we’re suddenly tied!
lines.zh: : 比赛继续，而且我们突然打平了！

lines.en: : Damn. Foiled again.
lines.zh: : 可恶。又被挫败了。

lines.en: : The rules this time are simple and, unlike how it was at the cafe, there will be {i}no{/i} caveats at all.
lines.zh: : 这次的规则很简单，而且跟在咖啡馆那次不同，{i}绝对没有{/i}任何附加条件。

lines.en: : Each of you will have five minutes to perform either an original scene or an adaptation of a scene from a book or a movie.
lines.zh: : 你们每人有五分钟，表演一段原创场景，或者改编自某本书、某部电影里的一个场景。

lines.en: : You were all notified yesterday that you’re allowed to use up to two other members from your floor as supporting actors, so I hope you used that time wisely to rehearse!
lines.zh: : 昨天已经通知过你们，最多可以带本楼层另外两名成员当助演，所以我希望你们好好利用了那段时间排练！

lines.en: : Rehearsing is for the weak. A true actor can adapt to any situation, no matter the preparation done beforehand.
lines.zh: : 排练是弱者干的事。真正的演员能适应任何情况，无论事先做了多少准备。

lines.en: : A question, if I may?
lines.zh: : 可以问个问题吗？

lines.en: scene skitwar5
: Sure! Molly, right?
lines.zh: : 当然！你是 Molly，对吧？

lines.en: : Aye. I’m just curious about who’s inside of the dolphin this time as Sana has already made an appearance.
lines.zh: : 是的。我只是好奇这次海豚里面是谁，毕竟 Sana 已经露过面了。

lines.en: : I thought I knew who it was, but Niki’s still on the way. Which really just makes me question how so many people have access to this one specific dolphin costume.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为自己知道是谁，可 Niki 还没到。这真让我怀疑，怎么会有那么多人都能弄到这同一件海豚装。

lines.en: : Hello. It is I. A dolphin.
lines.zh: : 你好。正是在下。一只海豚。

lines.en: scene skitwar6
: Wait a sec, are you tellin’ me you ain’t a whale?
lines.zh: : 等等，你是在告诉我你不是鲸鱼？

lines.en: : This whole time, I thought you were a whale.
lines.zh: : 这么久以来，我一直以为你是鲸鱼。

lines.en: : Miku...come on.
lines.zh: : Miku……拜托。

lines.en: : This could be problematic, but whatever. We’re rolling with it.
lines.zh: : 这可能会有问题，不过算了。就这么来吧。

lines.en: : Why would that ever be problematic?
lines.zh: : 为什么会出问题？

lines.en: : And roll you shall. That said, if there are no questions, we can go ahead and clear the stage for the first performance — Miku’s take on a scene from Moby Dick.
lines.zh: : 那就这么来吧。话说回来，如果没有别的问题，我们可以清场，开始第一场表演——Miku 演绎《白鲸记》里的一个场景。

lines.en: : Oh, that’s why it would be problematic.
lines.zh: : 噢，原来问题出在这儿。

lines.en: : I tried to warn her. I really did.
lines.zh: : 我提醒过她。我真的提醒过。

lines.en: : Well, warn me harder next time! Maki’s probably got a whale costume somewhere that we could have used instead of this one.
lines.zh: : 那下次提醒得再用力点！Maki 那儿大概有一套鲸鱼装，我们本来可以用那套的。

lines.en: : I can’t tell which part of me is stronger right now — the one that hopes you fail as penance for your idiocy or the one that must win at all costs.
lines.zh: : 我现在分不清自己哪一面更强——是希望你失败、好为你的蠢赎罪的那一面，还是不惜一切代价也要赢的那一面。

lines.en: : Lies. We both know it’s the winning one, Makoto. Just be thankful I’m the one actin’ and you just have to be a whale.
lines.zh: : 骗人。我们俩都知道是想赢的那一面，Makoto。你就庆幸吧，演戏的是我，你只要当一头鲸鱼就行。

lines.en: scene skitwar7
: {i}I have to act too because you apparently gave the whale lines!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也得演啊，因为你显然给鲸鱼安排了台词！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, it ain’t exciting if it’s just me talking! Now, hurry up and get your butt to your damn mark thingy!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哼，光我一个人说话多没劲！好了，快把你的屁股挪到那个该死的站位上去！{/i}

lines.en: : Is there some sort of reason you keep looking off to the side instead of directly into my eyes?
lines.zh: : 你一直往旁边看，不肯直视我的眼睛，是有什么原因吗？

lines.en: : Niki’s going to be showing up soon, Maya. Are you sure you want to be standing next to me when she does?
lines.zh: : Niki 快到了，Maya。你确定她来的时候要站在我旁边？

lines.en: : Do I look like a kid to you?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像小孩吗？

lines.en: : You-
: Don’t actually answer that question. All it will do is further damage your already-declining mental state.
lines.zh: : 别真的回答那个问题。那只会让你本已在下滑的精神状态雪上加霜。

lines.en: : You know me so well.
lines.zh: : 你真了解我。

lines.en: scene skitwar8
: Well enough to know you’ve probably already made it through your weird inner-monologue for the night and that the current moment we exist inside is just a bridge to the next one.
lines.zh: : 了解到了解到，你大概已经把今晚那段奇怪的内心独白走完了，而我们此刻所处的这一瞬，不过是通往下一瞬的桥。

lines.en: : At least it isn’t made of magpies.
lines.zh: : 至少它不是用喜鹊搭的。

lines.en: : In a sense, I think it is. And, in a different sense, I probably should be stepping aside right now to prevent my own {i}mental{/i} decline.
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说，我觉得它就是。而从另一种意义上说，我现在大概该让开，好阻止我自己{i}精神{/i}上的下滑。

lines.en: : {size=-2}But unfortunately, being by your side somehow trumps the prospect of crying myself to sleep later when you abandon me for your childhood friend. So I guess I’ll just stand around and wait for the suffering to begin.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}但可惜的是，待在你身边，不知怎么就压过了「等你为了青梅竹马抛弃我之后再哭着入睡」的前景。所以我想，我就这么站着，等苦难开场吧。{/size}

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Maya.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Maya。

lines.en: scene skitwar9
: You’re {i}sorry?{/i} After we’re finally starting to patch things up, you’re {i}sorry?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}对不起{/i}？在我们终于开始修补关系之后，你跟我说{i}对不起{/i}？

lines.en: : About which part, Sensei? Casting me to the wayside the first opportunity you got? Or the fact that I had to find out from fucking {i}Instagram?{/i}
lines.zh: : 是为哪件事，老师？一有机会就把我丢到一边？还是说我他妈得从{i}Instagram{/i}上才知道这件事？

lines.en: : Which I don’t even {i}like,{/i} by the way. I only made one so I could stalk your stupid childhood friend who I am absolutely jealous of but still hate with a fiery passion.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，我根本{i}不喜欢{/i}那个东西。我注册它，只是为了跟踪你那个愚蠢的青梅竹马——我嫉妒她嫉妒得要命，可同时又恨她恨得咬牙切齿。

lines.en: : Thank you for your honesty at least.
lines.zh: : 至少谢谢你的坦诚。

lines.en: scene skitwar10
: Don’t {i}thank{/i} me for it. Just pay me back with your own.
lines.zh: : 别为这个{i}谢{/i}我。用你自己的坦诚还我就行。

lines.en: : What happened to {i}trying?{/i} To seeing me as me and not the version you lost? We both love you the same. And I bet you’d have chosen {i}her{/i} over Niki, wouldn’t you? So why not me?
lines.zh: : {i}努力{/i}去哪儿了？把我当成我、而不是你失去的那个版本，去哪儿了？我们两个都一样爱你。而且我敢打赌，如果是{i}她{/i}和 Niki，你会选她，对吧？那为什么不能是我？

lines.en: : How come every single time I think things are going to change for the better, some cruel twist of fate shows up to drag me back to the sad reality that is falling for someone twice your age?
lines.zh: : 为什么每当我以为事情会变好，就会有某个残忍的命运转折出现，把我拽回那个可悲的现实——我爱上了一个年纪是我两倍的人？

lines.en: scene skitwar11
: I’m not avoiding you this time, don’t worry. And I’m not going to hide you from Niki either if that’s what you’re worried about.
lines.zh: : 这次我没有躲着你，别担心。如果你担心的是这个，我也不会把你藏着不让 Niki 知道。

lines.en: : I don’t care about the {i}hiding{/i} part. I grew up hiding because of the nature of our relationship. I will {i}hide{/i} all fucking day if that’s what you want from me.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎{i}藏{/i}不藏。我从小就在躲藏，因为我们之间关系的性质。只要你要我{i}藏{/i}，我可以他妈的藏一整天。

lines.en: : I just don’t want you conflicted. And I want to feel like your heart is {i}mine{/i} to destroy instead of hers since that’s been my biggest fear all along.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你左右为难。而且我想感觉到，你的心是{i}我的{/i}，该由我来毁灭，而不是她的——因为这一直是我最大的恐惧。

lines.en: scene skitwar12
: The only person allowed to destroy my heart is me. And I will be damned if I don’t do it every single chance I get.
lines.zh: : 唯一有权毁掉我的心的只有我自己。要是我放过任何一个机会不这么做，那我就该死。

lines.en: : I remembered something yesterday. Just...randomly. And I lost the fucking {i}drawing{/i} competition because of it. Me. Drawing. Of all fucking things. And to Yasu, of all people.
lines.zh: : 我昨天想起了一件事。就……突然想起来的。然后我就因为他妈的{i}画画{/i}比赛输了。我。画画。在所有该死的事情里偏偏是画画。而且在所有人里偏偏输给了 Yasu。

lines.en: : I didn’t even realize you {i}could{/i} draw.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你{i}会{/i}画画。

lines.en: : You know I can draw. Your brain is just shit from years worth of being sodomized by Father Time. But my memory was of a talk we had.
lines.zh: : 你知道我会画。你的脑子只是被时间之父操了那么多年，烂掉了。不过我记起的是我们之间的一次谈话。

lines.en: : Where I specifically {i}told{/i} you that this day would come. That Niki would waltz back into your life and you’d stop caring about me.
lines.zh: : 我当时{i}明确跟你说过{/i}会有这一天。Niki 会翩然回到你的生活里，然后你就不再在乎我了。

lines.en: : Now, that is happening and I am scared. And I will not {i}lie{/i} about being scared because I want you to help me feel safe. And if you don’t, I’m probably just going to turn into another Ami or something.
lines.zh: : 现在，这一切正在发生，而我害怕。我不会{i}撒谎{/i}说自己不怕，因为我想让你帮我感到安心。要是你不肯，我大概就会变成另一个 Ami 什么的。

lines.en: : That’s the single worst threat a person can make to me.
lines.zh: : 这是一个人能对我说出的最糟的威胁。

lines.en: scene skitwar13
: Then look me in the eyes and say you’ll do all you can to prevent it. That you love me. And will {i}continue{/i} to love me even when that girl says you’re not allowed to.
lines.zh: : 那就看着我的眼睛，说你会尽一切所能阻止它发生。说你爱我。而且就算那个女孩说你不许爱，你也会{i}继续{/i}爱我。

lines.en: : Maya...there is nothing or {i}no one{/i} in this world that is going to stop me from loving you. Okay? My life with Niki is entirely different from my life with you.
lines.zh: : Maya……这个世界上没有任何事、{i}任何人{/i}能阻止我爱你。好吗？我和 Niki 的生活，与我和你的生活完全不同。

lines.en: scene skitwar14
: Feel better?
lines.zh: : 好受点了吗？

lines.en: : A little...
lines.zh: : 好一点了……

lines.en: : I still feel expendable, though. And I wish sometimes that you’d just lock me in some secret room again so I wouldn’t have to watch from the windows as you torch the world I’ve come to love.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是觉得自己是可以被舍弃的。有时候我真希望你把我重新锁进某个秘密房间里，这样我就不用站在窗边，看着你把我渐渐爱上的这个世界付之一炬。

lines.en: : This world was on fire long before you and I were a part of it.
lines.zh: : 早在你我成为它的一部分之前，这个世界就已经在燃烧了。

lines.en: : Unless I {i}made{/i} it, you mean...
lines.zh: : 除非那火是{i}我{/i}放的，你是这个意思吧……

lines.en: scene skitwar15
: ...Yeah.
: Unless you made it.
lines.zh: : 除非是你放的。

lines.en: : Do you think I could destroy it too if that’s really the case?
lines.zh: : 如果真是这样，你觉得我也能毁掉它吗？

lines.en: : Do you want to?
lines.zh: : 你想吗？

lines.en: : Sometimes.
lines.zh: : 有时候想。

lines.en: : I’ll want to less if you just...stop making me mad, though.
lines.zh: : 不过只要你……别老惹我生气，我就没那么想了。

lines.en: : I’m going to keep making you mad so long as we both exist here.
lines.zh: : 只要我们两个都还在这里，我就会继续惹你生气。

lines.en: : Then don’t hold it against me if we just {i}stop{/i} existing one day.
lines.zh: : 那要是有一天我们干脆就{i}不{/i}存在了，你可别怪我。

lines.en: : {i}I turn my body into the sun!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我把身体化作太阳！{/i}

lines.en: scene skitwar16
: {i}From{/i} the sun, Miku. Ahab does not {i}become{/i} the sun.
lines.zh: : {i}来自{/i}太阳，Miku。亚哈不会{i}变成{/i}太阳。

lines.en: : Silence, whale! For you will soon taste the sting of my blade after doing all of those very bad things you did! What a ho Tashtego is! Let me have a hammer!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，鲸鱼！你做了那么多坏事，马上就要尝到我的刀锋了！塔什提哥真是个蠢货！把锤子给我！

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}Oh no, Captain Ahab. Please turn your harpoons away from my whale-ish body. I am not yet prepared to be...penetrated so violently by your many men on this tragic day.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}噢不，亚哈船长。请把你的鱼叉从我这条鲸一般的身上挪开。在这个悲惨的日子里，我还没准备好被你那许多手下如此粗暴地……刺穿。

lines.en: : Oh! Yet three unsurrendered pirates of mine, a cracked heel, and God keeps bullying the hull! Why must you be so firm and naughty?!
lines.zh: : 噢！我那三个还不肯投降的海盗、船 heel 上裂了一道缝，还有上帝一直在欺负船体！你为什么非要这么坚挺又这么坏？！

lines.en: : I am going to kill myself tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚要去死。

lines.en: scene skitwar17
: Pointy pole prow! Glorious death-ship! Must ye then perish? And without {i}me?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 尖尖的杆子船首！辉煌的死亡之船！你竟非要就此毁灭吗？而且还是在没有{i}我{/i}的情况下？！

lines.en: scene skitwar18
: Am I cut off from the last fondue for the meanest shipwrecked captains?! Oh, lonely death! Oh, lonely life!
lines.zh: : 难道连给最卑鄙的遇难船长准备的最后一锅奶酪火锅都没我的份了吗？！噢，孤独的死亡！噢，孤独的人生！

lines.en: scene skitwar19
: I am a whale. Fear me. Ahab must die.
lines.zh: : 我是鲸鱼。怕我吧。亚哈必须死。

lines.en: : Would it kill ya to be a little more enthusiastic? We’re friggin’ {i}acting{/i} here, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 你能不能稍微热情一点，会死吗？我们可是在{i}演戏{/i}啊，Makoto！

lines.en: : I AM A WHALE. FEAR ME. AHAB MUST DIE.
lines.zh: : 我是鲸鱼。怕我吧。亚哈必须死。

lines.en: scene skitwar20
: That’s more like it! And now I feel my topside greatness lie on top of my grief! Ho, ho, ho! From all your furthest boundaries, I’ll pour you a drink and comb your hair! Then die!
lines.zh: : 这才像话！现在，我感到我那浮在水面上的伟大，正压在我的悲痛之上！嗬，嗬，嗬！从你最遥远的边界，我要给你斟一杯酒、替你梳头！然后去死吧！

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : Towards thee, I roll! You big, stupid whale! To the last, I grapple with thee! From hell’s heart, I {i}stab{/i} at thee! For hate’s sake, I spit my last {i}breath{/i} at thee!
lines.zh: : 我向你滚来！你这头又大又蠢的鲸鱼！我要与你搏斗到最后！从地狱的心脏，我向你{i}刺{/i}去！为了仇恨，我把最后一口{i}气{/i}吐向你！

lines.en: scene skitwar21
: Sink your damn coffins are horses into the pool. And since neither can be mine, let me tear them into pieces while chasing thee! {i}Tied{/i} to thee, you stupid whale!
lines.zh: : 把你那该死的棺材和马都沉进池子里吧。既然两者都不属于我，就让我一边追你一边把它们撕成碎片！{i}缠{/i}着你，你这头蠢鲸鱼！

lines.en: : I AM SOMEHOW VICTORIOUS. WHALES RULE AND HUMANS SUCK.
lines.zh: : 我不知怎么就赢了。鲸鱼最棒，人类最烂。

lines.en: : And thus...
lines.zh: : 于是……

lines.en: scene skitwar22
: I give up my spear...
lines.zh: : 我放弃我的长矛……

lines.en: : That’s a sword.
lines.zh: : 那是把剑。

lines.en: scene skitwar23
: Done! That went better than I thought it would.
lines.zh: : 结束了！比我想的顺利。

lines.en: scene skitwar24
: Imani.
lines.zh: : Imani。

lines.en: : Please don’t tell me I have failed her as a teacher.
lines.zh: : 别告诉我，我作为老师辜负了她。

lines.en: : You have failed this girl as a teacher. Not only was 80%% of that monologue incorrect, the incorrect parts didn’t even make {i}sense.{/i}
lines.zh: : 作为老师，你确实辜负了这个女孩。那段独白不仅有 80%% 是错的，而且错的地方甚至{i}不通{/i}。

lines.en: : In Miss Imai’s defense, Miku is beyond help.
lines.zh: : 替 Imai 老师说句公道话，Miku 已经没救了。

lines.en: : You ain’t much further behind, Ami. Least outside of writing.
lines.zh: : 你也差不了多少，Ami。至少在写作之外是这样。

lines.en: scene skitwar25
: There’s no shame in having a specialty. I just put all of my effort toward that instead of math and history since that stuff won’t really matter in the grand scheme of things.
lines.zh: : 有专长并不丢人。我只是把全部精力都投在那上面，而不是数学和历史，因为从大局来看那些东西并不真的重要。

lines.en: : The whole world is sort of built upon those things, though.
lines.zh: : 可整个世界多少就是建立在那上面的。

lines.en: : And yet, you deliver this message with words and not numbers or the names of presidents.
lines.zh: : 然而你传达这条信息时用的是文字，而不是数字或总统的名字。

lines.en: : Have you still been writing lately, Arakawa Jr.? I’m interested in seeing more of your work if you feel like sharing any of it.
lines.zh: : Arakawa Jr.，你最近还在写作吗？如果你愿意分享，我很想看看你更多的作品。

lines.en: : Oh, that wouldn’t be appropriate. My recent work would tarnish your image of me. It’s far too raw and sexual.
lines.zh: : 噢，那不太合适。我近期的作品会毁掉你心目中的我。它太露骨、太色情了。

lines.en: : Never again do I want to hear those words come out of your mouth. Got it?
lines.zh: : 我再也不想听到那些话从你嘴里说出来。明白吗？

lines.en: scene skitwar26
: Now, wait one moment. There’s nothing wrong with exploring such themes at Arakawa Jr.’s age.
lines.zh: : 等等。在 Arakawa Jr. 这个年纪探索这类主题并没有什么错。

lines.en: : Poetry for girls like us is but one form of expression. And it’s better she gets those feelings out in an artistic way rather than a destructive one that bleeds into reality.
lines.zh: : 对我们这样的女孩来说，诗歌只是一种表达形式。她用艺术的方式把那些情感释放出来，总好过用一种会渗进现实里的破坏性方式。

lines.en: : Yeah, because artistry never bleeds into reality.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为艺术从来不会渗进现实。

lines.en: : That’s not what I said. I just think there’s no crime being committed here.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。我只是觉得这里没有犯下什么罪。

lines.en: : And that, if there was, it’d be wrong of you to turn a blind eye to your beloved Fukuyama who, last I heard, spends a great deal of her free time writing smut in the school library.
lines.zh: : 而且就算有，你对你心爱的 Fukuyama 视而不见也是不对的——我最近听说，她把大量空闲时间都花在图书馆里写色情小说上了。

lines.en: scene skitwar27
: Woah, hold on! We ain’t engaging in some war of our own where we’ve gotta choose a girl, are we? I ain’t favoring Futaba. She shouldn’t be writing that stuff in school either.
lines.zh: : 哇，等等！我们不会又要打一场自己的仗、非得选一个女孩吧？我可不是在偏袒 Futaba。她也不该在学校里写那种东西。

lines.en: : Miss Watabe likes me now since I told her she should be my new mom.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师现在喜欢我了，因为我跟她说她该当我的新妈妈。

lines.en: : Bitch, I’m right here.
lines.zh: : 贱人，我就在这儿。

lines.en: : Don’t call your students “bitch.”
lines.zh: : 别叫你的学生「贱人」。

lines.en: : That word’s empowering now, though.
lines.zh: : 可这个词现在是有赋权力量的。

lines.en: : Not when used in a derogatory fashion.
lines.zh: : 用在贬义的时候没有。

lines.en: scene skitwar28
: Also, this has nothing to do with your comments regarding the nature of motherhood and me.
lines.zh: : 另外，这和你那些关于母性以及我的评论毫无关系。

lines.en: : And even if there are things that have made me question such principles as of late, I am not willing to bend on this aspect of my character.
lines.zh: : 就算最近有些事让我开始质疑这些原则，我也不打算在我性格的这一面上让步。

lines.en: : I can bend. I’m pretty flexible.
lines.zh: : 我能让步。我挺灵活的。

lines.en: : But would I be allowed to say things like “raw” and “sexual” around you?
lines.zh: : 那我在你面前能说「露骨」「色情」这类词吗？

lines.en: : I’d really prefer you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我真的希望你别。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think it’s going to work then.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我看我们是没戏了。

lines.en: scene skitwar29
: What, shall this speech be spoke for our excuse? Or shall we on without apology?
lines.zh: : 怎么，这番话是要当作我们的借口来说？还是说我们不必道歉，径直进场？

lines.en: : The date is out of such prolixity. We’ll have no Cupid hoodwinked with a scarf, bearing a Tartar’s painted bow of lath, scaring the ladies like a crowkeeper.
lines.zh: : 这种啰唆早已过时。我们不要那个蒙着眼罩、拿着鞑靼人彩色木弓、像赶乌鸦人一样吓唬小姐们的丘比特。

lines.en: : Nor no without-book prologue, faintly spoke after the prompter, for our entrance. But let them measure us by what they will. We’ll measure them a measure and be gone.
lines.zh: : 也不要那种照着提词人、有气无力念出来的开场白。他们爱怎么衡量我们，随他们去。我们也量给他们一段舞，然后走人。

lines.en: : Give me a torch. I am not for this ambling. Being but heavy, I will bear the light.
lines.zh: : 给我一支火把。我可不想这么慢吞吞地晃。我心情沉重，就让我来掌灯吧。

lines.en: scene skitwar30
: Nay, gentle Romeo, we must have you dance.
lines.zh: : 不，好罗密欧，我们一定要你跳。

lines.en: : Not I, believe me. You have dancing shoes with nimble soles. I have a soul of lead so stakes me to the ground I cannot move.
lines.zh: : 我不跳，相信我。你有轻快的舞鞋，我的心却像铅一样沉，把我钉在地上，动弹不得。

lines.en: : You are a lover. Borrow Cupid’s wings and soar with them above a common bound.
lines.zh: : 你是个情人。借丘比特的翅膀，飞越凡俗的界限吧。

lines.en: : I am too sore enpiercèd with his shaft to soar with his light feathers, and so bound I cannot bound a pitch above dull woe. Under love’s heavy burden do I sink.
lines.zh: : 我被他的箭刺得太痛，无法借他轻盈的羽毛高飞；被束缚得太紧，跳不出苦闷的深渊。我在爱情的重负下沉没。

lines.en: : And to sink in it should you burden love — Too great oppression for a tender thing.
lines.zh: : 而你要是把爱情也压上一起沉没——那对这温柔的东西，压迫太重了。

lines.en: : Is love a tender thing? It is too rough, too rude, too boist’rous, and it pricks like thorn.
lines.zh: : 爱情是温柔的东西吗？它太粗暴、太无礼、太狂暴，像荆棘一样扎人。

lines.en: : If love be rough with you, be rough with love. Prick love for pricking, and you beat love down.
lines.zh: : 爱情若对你粗暴，你就对它粗暴。它扎你，你就扎它，这样你就能把爱情打倒。

lines.en: : Give me a case to put my visage in — A visor for a visor. What care I what curious eye doth cote deformities? Here are the beetle brows shall blush for me.
lines.zh: : 给我一个面具好把脸藏起来——用面具遮面具。我何必在意好奇的眼睛打量我的丑陋？就让这双浓眉替我脸红吧。

lines.en: scene skitwar31
: Wakana...this ain’t what I think it is, is it?
lines.zh: : Wakana……这不会是我想的那样吧？

lines.en: : Romeo and Juliet — Act 1, Scene 4.
lines.zh: : 《罗密欧与朱丽叶》——第一幕第四场。

lines.en: : This bitch ain’t gonna do the fuckin’ Queen Mab monologue, is she?
lines.zh: : 这个贱人不会真要把那该死的「麦布女王」独白念出来吧？

lines.en: : Again with the “bitch” thing.
lines.zh: : 又来了，「贱人」这个词。

lines.en: : Queen Mab?
lines.zh: : 麦布女王？

lines.en: scene skitwar32
: It’s a scene in which Romeo’s good friend, Mercutio, mocks Romeo for believing in his dreams of love.
lines.zh: : 那一场里，罗密欧的好友茂丘西奥嘲笑罗密欧相信自己关于爱的梦。

lines.en: : Does Mercutio not believe in love?
lines.zh: : 茂丘西奥不相信爱情吗？

lines.en: : He is a cynic. So it’s less that he doesn’t believe in love as a concept, but more that those who dream of it and pursue said dreams are blind to the chaos and irrationality they may potentially breed in doing so.
lines.zh: : 他是个愤世嫉俗的人。与其说他不相信爱情这个概念，不如说他认为那些梦想爱情、并去追逐梦想的人，看不见这么做可能滋生的混乱与非理性。

lines.en: scene skitwar33
: It’s an excellent monologue, really. Perhaps the best in the entire play.
lines.zh: : 那是一段极出色的独白，真的。也许是全剧里最好的。

lines.en: : But it can be quite difficult to capture Mercutio’s brand of sarcastic whimsy, so someone inexperienced attempting it could potentially be quite terrible, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 不过茂丘西奥那种讽刺式的奇想很难拿捏，所以让一个没经验的人来试，综合考虑之下可能会相当糟糕。

lines.en: : You say that, but Tsuneyo seems pretty locked in right now.
lines.zh: : 你倒是这么说，可 Tsuneyo 现在看起来相当投入。

lines.en: scene skitwar34
: I mean, sir, in delay, we waste our lights; in vain, light lights by day. Take our good meaning, for our judgment sits five times in that ere once in our five wits.
lines.zh: : 我是说，先生，我们这样拖延，是在白白浪费灯火；白日点灯，徒劳无益。请接受我们的好意——我们的判断先凭直觉，五种理智反倒要迟上五倍。

lines.en: : And...And we mean well in going to this masque, but ’tis no wit to go.
lines.zh: : 而且……而且我们去参加这场假面舞会是出于好意，可去终归是不智的。

lines.en: : Why, may one ask?
lines.zh: : 请问为什么呢？

lines.en: : I dreamt a dream tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚做了一个梦。

lines.en: : And so did I.
lines.zh: : 我也做了一个。

lines.en: : Well...what was yours?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你梦到了什么？

lines.en: scene skitwar35
: That dreamers often lie.
lines.zh: : 做梦的人常常说谎。

lines.en: : In bed asleep while they do dream things true.
lines.zh: : 他们躺在床上睡着，却梦见真的事。

lines.en: : Ahh...then I see Queen Mab hath been with you.
lines.zh: : 啊……那么我知道，麦布女王来过你这儿了。

lines.en: : Q...Queen Mab?
lines.zh: : 麦、麦布女王？

lines.en: : She is...the fairies’ midwife.
lines.zh: : 她是……仙女的接生婆。

lines.en: scene skitwar36
: And she comes in shape no bigger than an agate stone on the forefinger of an alderman...drawn with a team of little atomi over men’s noses as they lie asleep.
lines.zh: : 她来时身形不过玛瑙石那么大，就镶在市参议员的食指上……由一队小小的原子拖着，趁人们睡着时从他们鼻子上碾过。

lines.en: : Her wagon spokes made of long spinners’ legs, the cover of the wings of grasshoppers, her traces of the smallest spider web, her collars of the moonshine’s wat’ry beams...
lines.zh: : 她的车轮辐条是长脚蜘蛛的腿，车篷是蚱蜢的翅膀，缰绳是最细的蛛丝，项圈是月光那水一般的清辉……

lines.en: scene skitwar37
: Her whip of cricket’s bone, the lash of film, her wagoner a small gray-coated gnat, not half so big as a round little worm pricked from the lazy finger of a maid.
lines.zh: : 她的鞭子是蟋蟀的骨头，鞭梢是一层薄膜，车夫是一只披灰衣的小蚋，还没有从懒丫头手指上挑出的圆圆小虫一半大。

lines.en: : Her chariot is an empty hazelnut, made by the joiner squirrel or old grub, time out o’ mind the fairies’ coachmakers. And in this state she gallops night by night through lovers’ brains, and then they dream of love.
lines.zh: : 她的马车是一只空榛子壳，出自松鼠木匠或老蛀虫之手——它们自古以来就是仙子的造车匠。她就这副模样，夜夜驰过情人的脑海，于是他们便梦见爱情。

lines.en: scene skitwar38
: On courtiers’ knees, that dream on cur’sies straight; O’er lawyers’ fingers, who straight dream on fees; O’er ladies’ lips, who straight on kisses dream...
lines.zh: : 她驰过大臣的膝盖，他们便立刻梦见行礼；驰过律师的手指，他们便立刻梦见讼费；驰过小姐的嘴唇，她们便立刻梦见亲吻……

lines.en: : Which oft the angry Mab with blisters plagues because their breaths with sweetmeats tainted are.
lines.zh: : 而这些嘴唇常被愤怒的麦布用水泡折磨，因为她们的呼吸被糖果弄脏了。

lines.en: scene skitwar39
: Sometime she gallops o’er a courtier’s nose, and then dreams he of smelling out a suit.
lines.zh: : 有时她驰过朝臣的鼻子，他便梦见自己嗅出了一桩请托。

lines.en: : And sometime comes she with a tithe-pig’s tail, tickling a parson’s nose as he lies asleep...then he dreams of {i}another{/i} benefice.
lines.zh: : 有时她拿着什一猪的尾巴来，在牧师睡着时挠他的鼻子……于是他便梦见{i}又一份{/i}圣俸。

lines.en: scene skitwar40
: Sometime she driveth o’er a soldier’s neck, and then dreams he of cutting foreign throats!
lines.zh: : 有时她驶过士兵的脖子，他便梦见割断异邦人的喉咙！

lines.en: : Of breaches! Ambuscadoes! Spanish blades! Of healths five fathom deep! And then anon drums in his ear, at which he starts and wakes and, being thus frighted, swears a prayer or two and sleeps again.
lines.zh: : 梦见缺口！埋伏！西班牙利刃！梦见深达五噚的祝酒！随即鼓声在他耳边响起，他惊醒过来，受此惊吓，便含糊念上一两段祷词，又睡了过去。

lines.en: scene skitwar41
: This is that very Mab...that plats the manes of horses in the night and bakes the elflocks in foul sluttish hairs, which once untangled much misfortune bodes.
lines.zh: : 这正是那个麦布……她在夜里把马鬃编成辫子，把邋遢头发里的鬼结烘硬，一旦解开，便预示着种种灾祸。

lines.en: : This is the hag, when maids lie on their backs, that presses them and learns them first to bear, making them women of good carriage...
lines.zh: : 就是这个老巫婆，在少女们仰卧时压在她们身上，教她们初次承受，把她们变成仪态端庄的女人……

lines.en: : This is she.
lines.zh: : 就是她。

lines.en: : Peace...Peace, Mercutio, peace.
lines.zh: : 别说了……别说了，茂丘西奥，别说了。

lines.en: : Thou talk’st of nothing.
lines.zh: : 你说了半天，什么也没说。

lines.en: : True, I talk of dreams...which are the children of an idle brain, begot of nothing but vain fantasy, which is as thin of substance as the air and more inconstant than the wind...
lines.zh: : 不错，我说的是梦……梦是懒散头脑生出的孩子，不过是空虚幻想的产物，实质比空气还稀薄，比风还要变幻无常……

lines.en: : Who woos even now the frozen bosom of the north and, being angered, puffs away from thence, turning his side to the dew-dropping south...
lines.zh: : 此刻它正去向北方冰封的胸怀求爱，一怒之下又从那里拂袖而去，转过身去投向滴着露水的南方……

lines.en: scene skitwar42
: Oh my god. I had no idea you had such a good actress in your class, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我的天。我不知道你们班还有这么优秀的女演员，Sana。

lines.en: : Neither did I. I always figured I was the best until literally right now.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我一直以为我才是演得最好的，直到就在此刻。

lines.en: : She’s not usually like that either, is she? I’ve seen her before. She’s normally all...quiet and mild-mannered, right? So {i}tall{/i} too.
